items.title: Hamas replaces military wing leader, IDF reports 19 Gaza ceasefire violations May 6–20
items.summary: After the elimination of Al Qassam Brigades leader Izz al Din al Haddad on May 15, Hamas has reportedly turned to longtime senior member Mohammed Odeh to take the reins of the group’s military wing. items.title: Saudi Arabia and UAE say drone attacks were launched from Iraq
items.summary: Saudi Arabia and the United Arab Emirates said that recent drone attacks targeting their territory originated from Iraq, increasing pressure on Baghdad to address the activities of Iranian-backed militias operating inside the country. The incidents come amid continued regional tensions involving Iran and have intensified scrutiny of Iraq’s newly formed government. The post Saudi Arabia and UAE...

items.title: Iran claims it coordinated passage of 26 vessels out of Hormuz in 24 hours
items.summary: The IRGC Navy stated it coordinated the transit of 26 vessels through the Strait of Hormuz in the past 24 hours, with traffic requiring IRGC permission under the new Persian Gulf Strait Authority framework.

items.title: Iran reviews U.S. peace proposal as Trump says he's willing to wait 'a few days'
items.summary: Trump said he was prepared to wait a few more days for Tehran to respond to the U.S. peace proposal, while warning of renewed attacks if an acceptable deal is not reached.

items.title: Trump calls off Iran attack planned for Tuesday amid 'serious negotiations'
items.summary: Trump said he postponed a planned strike on Iran at the request of Gulf leaders, saying he had instructed forces to be ready for a full-scale assault on a moment's notice if no deal is reached.

items.title: Exclusive: U.S. and Iran closing in on one-page memo to end war, officials say
items.summary: A 14-point MOU is being negotiated to declare an end to the war and begin a 30-day detailed negotiation period covering the Strait of Hormuz, Iran's nuclear program, and sanctions relief.

items.title: USD remittance rate hits 1,787,000 IRR on May 21 — up 19,000 from prior day
items.summary: Iran's free-market remittance dollar rate reached 1,787,000 IRR on May 21, 2026, a 1.07% daily gain, keeping the currency well below the 2,000,000 threshold but under continued war-premium pressure.

items.title: IRGC Navy vows to enforce Khamenei's 'historic' directive on Persian Gulf new management
items.summary: Iran's IRGC Navy pledged to enforce Khamenei's April directive asserting sovereign control over the Persian Gulf and Hormuz, with the new Persian Gulf Strait Authority now requiring IRGC permission for all vessel transits.

items.title: Saudi Arabia and UAE say Iraq-based drones targeted Gulf territory
items.summary: Riyadh and Abu Dhabi publicly attributed recent drone attacks on their territory to Iranian-backed militias operating from Iraq, intensifying pressure on Baghdad amid ongoing Hormuz tensions.
